The '''Falko Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] running through the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] lying Rimward along the Falko Run included [[Ringneldia II]], [[Dilonexa XXIII]], [[Uaua/Legends|Uaua]], [[Paulking XIV]], and [[Douglas III]].

The Falko Run was connected to the more prominent [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] via the [[Cadma Conduit]].
